metadata.title: Propose Fixes
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Propose specific fixes for issues identified during review and verification. Use when you need to create detailed fix proposals and get user approval before applying fixes.

output.description: Fix proposals document and approval status

specificActions: Read issues from previous step, analyze each issue with context
Create detailed fix proposals with what, how, and why
Process approval response and store approved IDs
Support iterative revision if user requests changes

read: memory.json (previous step section: issues list path)

tools: read_file - Read memory, issues-list, findings, source files
grep or codebase_search - Understand issue context
bestPractices: Read issues systematically - process each issue in the list
For each issue, read the source file to understand full context
Create detailed proposals with what, how, and why
Log user interactions immediately when user responds
Support iterative revision if user requests changes

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Recall operating principles before starting this step
actions: Read `~/.claude/agentic-processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md` and recall all principles
Output: '✓ Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Read Issues from Previous Step
substeps.description: Read issues list path from memory and verify issues exist
actions: Read from memory.json: issues list path (issues-list.json reference)
Verify issues list exists and is not empty
Log: 'Found {count} issues to propose fixes for'

substeps.name: Read Issues JSON File
substeps.description: Read structured issues data from JSON file
actions: Read issues-list.json to get structured issues data
Extract all issue details: ID, location, description, category, severity

substeps.name: Create Fix Proposals for Each Issue
substeps.description: Analyze each issue and create detailed fix proposal
actions: For each issue:
Read source file to understand context
Determine best fix approach
Create detailed proposal with: Issue ID, Location, Issue description, Current state, Proposed fix, Fix instructions, Rationale
Log progress for each proposal created

substeps.name: Create Fix Proposals Document
actions: Create fix-proposals.md with all proposals
Include: Header with investigation scope, Summary, Individual proposals, Approval section

substeps.name: Present Proposals and Get Approval
substeps.description: Present proposals to user and wait for approval
actions: Present fix-proposals.md to user
Explain approval options: approve all, approve specific IDs, request changes, reject
Wait for user response
IMMEDIATELY log user interaction

substeps.name: Process Approval Response
substeps.description: Handle user's approval, modification request, or rejection
actions: If approved: Store approved IDs in memory
If changes requested: Revise and re-present
If rejected: Document rejection
Update memory with results

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Read issues → Read JSON file → Create proposals for each → Create document → Present for approval → Process response → Update memory

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Previous step section (issues list path, investigation context)
fields: Information Produced: Fix proposals document path, Total proposals created, Approval status, List of approved issue IDs

proposalElements.name: rationale
proposalElements.description: Why this fix addresses the issue
